steps.python:
d = ${d0}
ids = [x['id'] for x in d['devices']]
print('DEVICES', ids)
assert ids[:2] == ['keyboard', 'virtual'] and 'probe' in ids, ids
p = [x for x in d['devices'] if x['id'] == 'probe'][0]
assert p['owner'] == 'teleop_probe' and p['kind'] == 'six-axis' and p['label'] == 'Probe Puck', p
assert p['axes'] == ['tx', 'ty', 'tz', 'rx', 'ry', 'rz'] and p['buttons'] == ['left', 'right'], p
m = {x['id']: x for x in d['modes']}
assert list(m) == ['command', 'joint', 'ik', 'reach'] and m['reach']['owner'] == 'teleop_probe' and m['reach']['label'] == 'Reach', m
assert m['command']['quantities'] == ['vx', 'vy', 'wyaw'] and m['joint']['quantities'] == ['rate', 'next', 'prev'], m
assert m['ik']['quantities'] == ['x', 'y', 'z'] and m['reach']['quantities'] == [], m
assert d['device'] == 'keyboard' and d['mode'] == 'command', d

d = ${d1}
p = [x for x in d['devices'] if x['id'] == '${pad.id}']
print('PAD', p)
assert len(p) == 1 and p[0]['kind'] == 'virtual gamepad' and 'Smoke Pad' in p[0]['label'] and p[0]['owner'] == '', d['devices']
assert p[0]['axes'][:4] == ['leftx', 'lefty', 'rightx', 'righty'] and len(p[0]['axes']) == 6 and len(p[0]['buttons']) == 15, p

s = ${s1}
e = (0.6 - 0.1) / 0.9
q = s['quantities']
print('PAD_STATUS', s)
assert s['connected'] and s['on'] and s['device'] == '${pad.id}' and s['mode'] == 'command' and s['error'] == '', s
assert abs(s['axes']['lefty'] + 0.6) < 1e-3 and abs(s['axes']['rightx'] - 1.0) < 1e-6, s['axes']
assert abs(s['axes']['lefttrigger']) < 1e-3 and abs(s['axes']['righttrigger']) < 1e-3, s['axes']
assert abs(q['vx'] - e) < 1e-3 and abs(q['vy']) < 1e-6 and abs(q['wyaw'] + 1.0) < 1e-6, q
c = s['command']
assert abs(c[0] - e) < 1e-3 and abs(c[1]) < 1e-6 and abs(c[2] + 1.0) < 1e-6 and not s['controller'], s

s = ${s3}
q = s['quantities']
print('MAP_STATUS', s)
assert abs(s['axes']['righttrigger'] - 0.5) < 1e-3 and s['buttons']['a'] and not s['buttons']['b'], s
assert abs(q['vx'] - 2.0 * 0.4 / 0.9) < 2e-3 and abs(q['vy'] + 0.5) < 1e-6 and q['wyaw'] == 0.0, q

q = ${s4}['quantities']
assert abs(q['vx'] - 1.0) < 2e-3, q
assert '${pad.id}' not in [x['id'] for x in ${d2}['devices']], ${d2}

import builtins
t0 = builtins.tp_targets()
app.actions.run('teleop.input', axes={'lefty': 1.0})
t1 = builtins.tp_until(lambda t: t['elbow'] != t0['elbow'])
assert -2.4 < t1['elbow'] < t0['elbow'], (t0, t1)
builtins.tp_run_for(1.0)
app.actions.run('teleop.input', axes={'lefty': 0.0})
t2 = builtins.tp_until(lambda t: abs(t['elbow'] + 2.4) < 1e-5)
print('JOINT', t0, t1, t2)
assert all(t2[j] == t0[j] for j in ('shoulder_yaw', 'shoulder_pitch')), (t0, t2)
builtins.tp_frames(10)
assert builtins.tp_targets() == t2, builtins.tp_targets()

import builtins
app.actions.run('teleop.input', buttons={'rightshoulder': True})
builtins.tp_frames(4)
app.actions.run('teleop.input', buttons={'rightshoulder': False})
builtins.tp_frames(2)
s = app.actions.run('teleop.status')
assert s['joint'] == 'shoulder_yaw', s
app.actions.run('teleop.input', buttons={'leftshoulder': 1})
builtins.tp_frames(2)
app.actions.run('teleop.input', buttons={'leftshoulder': 0})
builtins.tp_frames(2)
s = app.actions.run('teleop.status')
assert s['joint'] == 'elbow' and s['quantities'] == {'rate': 0.0, 'next': 0.0, 'prev': 0.0}, s

import builtins, numpy as np, nuka
l = app.actions.run('robot.links')['links']
t = [i for i, x in enumerate(l) if x['joint'] == 'tool_mount'][0]
builtins.tp_tool = lambda: np.asarray(app.world.download_field(nuka.Field.ARTICULATION_LINK_POSE), dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1, 7)[t, :3].copy()
builtins.tp_root = l[0]['path']

import builtins, numpy as np
s = ${k0}
p0 = builtins.tp_tool()
print('IK0', s['goal'], p0)
assert s['error'] == '' and np.allclose(s['goal'], p0, atol=1e-4), (s, p0)
builtins.tp_goal0 = s['goal']

import builtins, time, numpy as np
g0 = builtins.tp_goal0
app.actions.run('teleop.input', axes={'righty': 1.0})
deadline = time.monotonic() + 30.0
while app.actions.run('teleop.status')['goal'][2] > g0[2] - 0.03:
    assert time.monotonic() < deadline
    app.update(True)
app.actions.run('teleop.input', axes={'righty': 0.0})
builtins.tp_frames(12)
g = np.asarray(app.actions.run('teleop.status')['goal'])
p = builtins.tp_tool()
d = float(np.linalg.norm(p - g))
print('IK_TELEOP', g, p, d)
assert g[0] == g0[0] and g[1] == g0[1] and 0.03 <= g0[2] - g[2] < 0.1, (g, g0)
assert d < 1e-3, d
builtins.tp_frames(10)
assert np.allclose(builtins.tp_tool(), p, atol=1e-6), (builtins.tp_tool(), p)

import builtins
app.actions.run('teleop.use', link='')
app.actions.run('scene.select', path=builtins.tp_root)
builtins.tp_frames(3)
s = app.actions.run('teleop.status')
assert s['error'] == 'select a robot link below its root' and s['link'] is None and s['goal'] is None, s

import builtins
s = ${e0}
r = (0.5 - 0.1) / 0.9
print('EXT', s)
assert s['connected'] and s['device'] == 'probe' and s['mode'] == 'reach' and s['error'] == '', s
assert abs(s['axes']['tz'] - 0.5) < 1e-6 and s['buttons'] == {'left': True, 'right': False}, s
assert abs(s['quantities']['reach'] - r) < 1e-5, s['quantities']
builtins.tp_until(lambda t: abs(t['elbow'] + r) < 1e-5 and abs(t['shoulder_pitch'] - 0.5 * r) < 1e-5)

st = ${el}
assert st['device']['id'] == 'probe' and abs(st['device']['axes']['tz'] - 0.5) < 1e-6 and st['device']['buttons'] == {'left': True, 'right': False}, st
assert [j['name'] for j in st['joints']] == ['shoulder_yaw', 'shoulder_pitch', 'elbow'] and st['dt'] > 0.0, st
assert abs(st['quantities']['reach'] - 0.4 / 0.9) < 1e-5, st

import builtins
app.actions.run('teleop_probe.set', buttons=[True, True])
builtins.tp_frames(3)
s = app.actions.run('teleop.status')
assert "set no joint 'nope'" in s['error'], s
app.actions.run('teleop_probe.set', buttons=[True, False])
builtins.tp_frames(3)
assert app.actions.run('teleop.status')['error'] == ''

import builtins
app.actions.run('teleop_probe.set', fail=True)
builtins.tp_frames(8)
e = [x for x in app.actions.run('extensions.list') if x['id'] == 'teleop_probe'][0]
print('EXT_FAIL', e)
assert 'teleop mode reach' in e['error'] and 'disabled' in e['error'], e
d = app.actions.run('teleop.devices')
assert 'probe' not in [x['id'] for x in d['devices']] and 'reach' not in [x['id'] for x in d['modes']], d
s = app.actions.run('teleop.status')
assert not s['connected'] and s['error'] == "no teleop mode 'reach'", s
